description: Season-boundary audit, the regression run (ECO report X3): across every layer, does each season change hand over cleanly? Lake, ocean and brook forts, spring -> summer -> autumn (two changes, 2,000 ticks past the second), 3 replicates, arms counterbalanced, DF restarted for every cell. Measured: off-cast arrivals per layer and season and their lead time after the change; in-cast groups trimmed or sent off; stand-ins; turnover send-offs that actually left; reserve conservation (state dump every chunk); tool time per pass. Passes with 0 off-cast arrivals later than one day after a change, 0 in-cast trims, and every dismissed group off the map within 10 days.
